# Investigate Performance

Investigate the stated performance concern from a concrete hot path and existing benchmark evidence.

Use [the performance context pack](../../.ai/context/performance.md) for task-specific guidance; repository policy remains in `AGENTS.md`. Do not reread guidance already in context.

## Completion

Report the bottleneck, evidence, proposed or requested implemented change, correctness checks, measurement limits, and bundle/payload risk. Add a benchmark only when a matching repository pattern exists or the user requests one.
